faqs.q: How much does a home solar system cost?
faqs.a: A 3kW home system costs roughly INR 66,000 to 78,000 installed before any subsidy. We confirm an exact fixed quote after the free site survey.

faqs.q: How long does installation take?
faqs.a: Most residential systems up to 10kW take 2 to 4 days on site. The full process from survey to grid connection usually takes 3 to 6 weeks.

faqs.q: How many panels do I need for a 4,000 rupee monthly bill?
faqs.a: A monthly bill around 4,000 rupees usually means a 3 to 4kW system, which needs about 6 to 8 panels and roughly 30 to 40 square metres of shadow-free roof. A site survey confirms the exact size.

faqs.q: Do you work in Delhi?
faqs.a: Our service areas are Bengaluru, Mysuru, Hubballi and Mangaluru. For locations outside these cities, please contact us and we will let you know if a visit is possible.

faqs.q: What warranty do I get on the battery?
faqs.a: 10 years or 6,000 cycles, whichever comes first.

faqs.q: How does net metering work?
faqs.a: Net metering lets you export surplus solar power to the grid and receive credit on your electricity bill. The utility installs a net meter after inspection and we handle the paperwork.

faqs.q: What is the current government subsidy?
faqs.a: Subsidy schemes change often. Our team confirms the current scheme and eligibility during the free site survey. We do not quote exact subsidy amounts.

faqs.q: What is the price of the 540W residential panel?
faqs.a: The Residential Mono PERC Panel 540W is priced at INR 22 to 26 per watt installed, as a sample range. An exact quote follows the site survey.

faqs.q: What is the price of the hybrid inverter?
faqs.a: The Hybrid Inverter 5kW is priced at INR 55,000 to 80,000 as a sample range.

faqs.q: What is the price of the 5kWh battery?
faqs.a: The Lithium Battery 5kWh is priced at INR 1.8 to 2.4 lakh as a sample range.

faqs.q: How much roof area do I need?
faqs.a: About 8 to 10 square metres of shadow-free roof per kW of solar.

faqs.q: How much electricity does 1kW produce?
faqs.a: In much of India, 1kW of rooftop solar produces roughly 4 to 5 units per day on average.

faqs.q: How long until the system pays for itself?
faqs.a: Home systems often pay back in 3 to 6 years depending on usage and tariff.

faqs.q: What maintenance is needed?
faqs.a: Clean panels every 2 to 4 weeks in dusty areas and check the inverter app weekly. Service plans include twice-yearly cleaning visits.

faqs.q: What does the panel warranty cover?
faqs.a: Product warranty 12 years and performance warranty 25 years, 30 on commercial bifacial panels.

faqs.q: What does the inverter warranty cover?
faqs.a: 5 years standard, extendable to 10 years.

faqs.q: What does the workmanship warranty cover?
faqs.a: 5 years on installation workmanship.

faqs.q: What is not covered by warranty?
faqs.a: Damage from misuse, unauthorised modification, flooding and natural disasters.

faqs.q: What are the payment options?
faqs.a: Bank transfer, UPI, cheque, and partner bank solar loans (sample).

faqs.q: What is the payment schedule?
faqs.a: Typical schedule: 30 percent advance, 60 percent on material delivery, 10 percent after commissioning (sample).

faqs.q: Can I return equipment?
faqs.a: Unused, unopened equipment can be returned within 7 days of delivery, subject to inspection (sample). Installed equipment is covered by warranty, not returns.
